notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug locking you in place if you taunted just as invisibility was ending
-Fixed the positioning of the first coin on level 2_12
-Fixed a few graphic bugs for zone 8
-Fixed bug with the 'Coin Completionist' achievement
-The game no longer hides/disabled the mouse when running to avoid interfering with accessibility software

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes: After working on Canadian Robot Racing League for many years, off and on, and learning a lot along the way - happy to say that it has been released and is available to play, right now, for free. So have a friend bring a controller or two over (or seven) and I hope people have some fun!
